architecture.workers: same global default1; independent mask fills/rows may parallelize after exactness; sequence calls remain ordered

execution_gate: root full source/safety review plus separately frozen authenticated capture runner; no calls authorized by this file

future_resource.call_bound: 192*N + 16MiB <= 256MiB for numeric uint8 outputs; conservative hull/grid/morphology copies

parity.ownership: input before/after and all returned pairwise identity/sharing; owning flags/base metadata
parity.policy: actual default policy/handler/bufsize unchanged; no setters
parity.sequences: ordered tuple, element dtype/shape/strides/raw/count type/aliases; never substitute dense
parity.values: exact dtype and all raw logical words; no tolerance

safety.hull: generated positive 2D arrays; possible_hull loops image bounds and allocates 2*(rows+cols) slots; hull vertices are nonempty finite 2D after offset expansion
safety.scope: owned valid storage only; bounded nonnegative integer generators and explicit pure-Python/NumPy intake errors
safety.sequence: nonempty rank1..3 owned uint8 footprints with nonzero support; known shape formula; positive counts except certified first/later zero controls; wrong-rank rejected by shape indexing before dilation

source_hazards: ellipse uses draw radii height+1,width+1 and strict distances<1; not a simple inclusive conic
ellipse crosses uses default uint8 in _cross_decomposition irrespective requested dtype
unknown ellipse decomposition reaches unbound local; octagon/octahedron explicitly ValueError
octagon/star use real convex hull including half-pixel offsets; source output must be observed before replacement
octagon sequence has small-shape dense special case, m=0 adjustment and rectangle sequence fallback warnings
octahedron nondecomposed fractional radii use mgrid complex-step semantics; sequence may contain zero repeats
first sequence footprint executes once even zero repeat; subsequent zero repeat executes zero times
even sequence masks are padded then mirrored; reflect boundaries and copy order are observable
